function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live clocks or real‑time data feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York right now.  
If you want to know the present local time there, you can:

1. **Check your phone or computer** – most devices display the time for multiple cities if you add “New York” to the world clock list.  
2. **Search online** – typing “current time in New York” into a search engine will give you the up‑to‑second result.  
3. **Use a world‑clock widget** – many smart‑phone apps let you pin New York’s time to your home screen.

Let me know if you’d like help setting up a world‑clock widget or adding New York to your device’s clock list!

But we can't guarantee DST. We could say "I don't have real-time capability." But maybe we can use an external API? Not allowed. So we should respond that I cannot fetch real-time data.
